mapper.select: SELECT pc.comment_id AS commentId, pc.property_id AS propertyId, pc.user_id AS userId, u.name AS nickname, pc.content, pc.created_at AS createdAt, pc.updated_at AS updatedAt, CASE WHEN pc.user_id = #{userId} THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS isMine FROM property_comment pc JOIN users u ON u.user_id = pc.user_id WHERE pc.property_id = #{propertyId} AND pc.del_yn = 'N' AND u.del_yn = 'N' ORDER BY pc.created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO property_comment (property_id, user_id, content) VALUES (#{propertyId}, #{userId}, #{content})
mapper.update: UPDATE property_comment SET del_yn = 'Y' WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND del_yn = 'N'
mapper.select: SELECT content FROM property_comment WHERE property_id = #{propertyId} AND del_yn = 'N'

SELECT tag_type AS tagType, CASE tag_type WHEN 1 THEN '현관보안 좋음' WHEN 2 THEN '귀갓길 밝음' WHEN 3 THEN '근처 유동인구 많음' WHEN 4 THEN '여성 전용 원룸' WHEN 5 THEN '관리인 상주' WHEN 6 THEN '외부인 출입 잦음' WHEN 7 THEN '귀갓길 어두움' WHEN 8 THEN '근처 인적 드묾' END AS tagName, CASE WHEN tag_type IN (6, 7, 8) THEN 'NEGATIVE' ELSE 'POSITIVE' END AS type, tag_count AS count FROM property_tag WHERE property_id = #{propertyId} ORDER BY tag_count DESC, tag_type ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO property_tag (property_id, tag_type, tag_count) VALUES (#{propertyId}, #{tagType}, #{tagCount})
